title: RequestPayment
description: Command from checkout: create and confirm a Stripe PaymentIntent for the checkout (idempotency key checkout-{checkoutId}-pay). One payment per checkoutId. Replies: payments.payment-succeeded or payments.payment-failed, always within 5 minutes. Keyed by checkoutId.

paymentMethodId.description: Stripe payment method from the storefront, e.g. pm_card_visa in test mode.
